audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read as a flat even skirmish lane; it is four stages of Qiyana followed by a hard flip at 6.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and content win[] agree on Qiyana x4 then Katarina x3, and the kit explains it: Terrashape is a 7s 1100-range dash, Audacity is a second dash at 11s rank 1, and her Q is a flat 7s with an element-dependent bonus. Pre-6 you cannot answer three mobility tools.
audit.corrected: Concede the wave to level 5, then take the lane at 6 in open ground where her R has no wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second' Audacity.
audit.why: Audacity is 11/10/9/8/7s. Elemental Wrath and Terrashape are both flat 7s. Supreme Display of Talent is a flat 120s at every rank.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in; the 120s ult in particular is a two-minute window she cannot repeat.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Qiyana can cancel Death Lotus, which is the single most punishing interaction in the matchup.
audit.why: Death Lotus is a channel any CC cancels. Qiyana carries hardCC on BOTH her Q (element-dependent) and her R. Her Q is a flat 7s, so the cancel threat is up almost permanently — the R is not the only thing to count.
audit.corrected: Written into dontsFull[1], breakdown.cooldowns and the Level 6 phase: bait the element Q before the channel, not just the ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet suspectNames flagged 'Supreme Display of Talent' and 'Bouncing Blade' as probable wrong names.
audit.why: Both are FALSE POSITIVES — Supreme Display of Talent is Qiyana's real R and Bouncing Blade is Katarina's real Q. Neither was changed.

audit.whatIsWrong: 11 lint findings: 7 misgenders (Qiyana is she/her), 2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 digit-free cooldowns field.
audit.why: Deterministic lint output in the brief.

edits.before: A reset duel — your daggers out-sustain his windows, and the first kill in any skirmish turns you into the weather.
edits.after: She owns the lane until 6 on three dashes and an element Q — then open ground takes her ult away and you take the lane.

edits.before: Drag the duel into a skirmish and let the resets vote. Every commit starts with one question: is Audacity down?
edits.after: Reach 6 healthy, then fight in open river or mid where Supreme Display has no wall to stun you into. Count her Q, not just her dash.

edits.before: Qiyana wins by landing Audacity, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Qiyana wins pre-6 with river-root or grass Q into a full element combo, and late by finding one wall to detonate her R against.

edits.before: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow.
edits.after: Trade with Audacity on cooldown — 11s at rank 1 with both dashes spent is the only window she cannot close on you.

edits.before: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: Shunpo to a dagger she is standing beside — that is a free element proc, a 7s Q and her whole rotation on a still target.

edits.before: Ahead, chain it: zone Qiyana off daggers, lotus every skirmish, and reset through the map — fed Katarina is a weather event.
edits.after: Ahead, hold the fights in open ground — with no wall her 120s ult is a shockwave that stuns nobody, and she has no second plan.

edits.before: Dagger geometry and patience — chip the no-CC kits, bait the CC ones, and bank patterns for the 6 that changes the lane's species.
edits.after: Stand away from river and brush so her Q is the plain version with no root and no stealth. Last-hit from range; you only need to reach 6 healthy.

edits.before: First item onward, hunt skirmishes: every 2v2 near your daggers is a reset chain waiting for a signature. Roam when mid stalls.
edits.after: From 6 the lane inverts: bait her element Q, then start Lotus — with that spent she has no cancel until her 120s R comes back.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-bounced thin push with daggers banked at the river mouth — your roams arrive with luggage. Worst wave: a frozen wave near a CC mage's tower — every pickup walk is a stun audition. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.
edits.after: Best wave: held near your tower before 6, so an Audacity in has no follow-up and no exit. Worst wave: pushed past river, where her grass Q goes invisible and her W reaches 1100 to you. Crash timing: shove blind only with river warded — her stealth roams are the reason this lane loses side lanes.

edits.before: - Qiyana Audacity: matchup-defining — Her stick dash — once spent she cannot reach you; kite the cooldown. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Shunpo (second use) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Audacity (E): 11s at rank 1, 7s at rank 5 — once it and Terrashape are spent she cannot reach you at all. - Her Q and Terrashape are both flat 7s, and the element Q hard-CCs, so it cancels Death Lotus. - Supreme Display is a flat 120s and needs a wall.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow. Bad trade: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: Good trade: take it with Audacity on cooldown — 11s at rank 1 with both dashes spent is the only window she cannot close. Bad trade: Shunpo to a dagger she is standing beside, which hands her a free element proc, a 7s Q and a full rotation on a still target.

edits.before: If Qiyana opens the score, reset expectations and respect Audacity doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q bounces and stay relevant through reset potential.
edits.after: If Qiyana opens the score, stop standing near brush or river entirely — a stealth Q on a fed Qiyana is the whole combo before you see her. After a second kill, farm the bounce under tower and play for the 6, where open ground still strips her ult of the wall it needs.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: You carry by outlasting her reload — she spends the whole kit on one target and stands empty for the next ten seconds.

edits.before: You are the cleanup that starts fights: enter on steel, lotus the clump, reset through the kill, and exit through the panic.
edits.after: Fight in open river or mid so the shockwave has nothing to knock you into, then take her flank on the way in and reset.
